document_copies.definition: A set of photocopies or photographs of your identity documents, kept apart from the originals, so they can be replaced quickly.
document_copies.example: I keep a copy of my passport at home and one in my email.

self_diagnosis.definition: Concluding what illness one has without a medical examination, usually from online information.

spoofing.definition: Presenting a false sender identity so that a call or a message appears to come from a number or address that belongs to someone else.
spoofing.example: The message showed my brother's name, but the number was spoofed.

standing_order.definition: A fixed amount you authorise to be paid on a schedule, whether or not the underlying bill is the same each month.
standing_order.example: I have a standing order to my landlord for the rent, and a direct debit for the utilities.

thorax.definition: The middle part of an insect's body. All six legs and the wings grow from it.
thorax.example: All six legs are attached to the thorax.
